mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND FLOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -3 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY FLOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND FLOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY FLOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND FLOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) AND date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY FLOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND FLOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND FLOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY FLOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'N' AND FLOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m'), '-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(FLOW_AVR, '-') AS FLOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM FLOW_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'Y' AND FLOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y'), '-01-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}
